title: Removing the lead asks the same clear-shifts question as changing it
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  4. At least 1 technicians are eligible at this location (e.g. "Esther Howard"). A staff member is eligible when Clockable is on, the staff record is Active, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member, enter a first and last name (e.g. "Esther Howard") and an email.
    • Pick a role that is not Office or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), turn Clockable on, keep the record Active, enrol the staff member at this location, then Save.
  5. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  6. Create two Approved work orders led by Esther Howard for the case customer (e.g. "S1-702", "S1-698").
  7. On the Schedule, give "Esther Howard" a shift on each of them tomorrow 8:00–12:00: Schedule > go to that day > drag the work order from the work order list onto Esther Howard's row at the start time > in the picker choose Entire work order > set the end time > save.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; in the design its button tooltip reads "Board").
  2. Type the case customer's name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") in Search.
  3. Drag "S1-702" from Esther Howard's column into the Unassigned column.
  4. Read the prompt's title, text and buttons, then click Keep shifts.
  5. Hover "S1-698", click More actions > Reassign lead technician, pick Unassigned and confirm.
  6. Read the prompt, then click Keep shifts.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Both removals open the same shift-clearing prompt as a change of lead: title "Clear Esther Howard's scheduled shifts?" with the buttons Keep shifts, Clear shifts and Cancel.
  • After Keep shifts both work orders are in Unassigned and Esther Howard's shifts are still on the Schedule.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S4-R26, S4-R29, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions DR-46 / FF-4. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R26: “Removing the lead technician (moving the work order to Unassigned) shows the same shift-clearing prompt as changing it (S4-R11).”
  • S4-R29: “The prompt reads: title “Clear {Name}'s scheduled shifts?” (with no name: “Clear the lead technician's scheduled shifts?”); text “{Name} has shifts scheduled for this whole work order. Clearing removes shifts that haven't started and ends one that's under way now. Shifts on individual lines and recorded time don't change.”; buttons “Keep shifts”, “Clear shifts” and “Cancel”.”
